verdict.rationale: Relay documents that most applications are reviewed within 1–2 business days, with status visible in-app and email notification on decision. That supports fast account opening, which is the core of a week-long onboarding. However, nothing documents an end-to-end onboarding or migration timeline (switching payments and integrations, receiving first cards), so 'fully onboard in about a week' is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding/switching timeline, migration assistance for moving existing payments and integrations, first-card delivery timing, independent corroboration of approval speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months
